status: Planning allocations, not validated vehicle mass estimates or propulsion feasibility

interstellar_relay_chain.status: Proposed design-to requirement; independent power, optical deployment, pointing and antimatter hardware feasibility unclosed
interstellar_relay_chain.receiver: Deployable very thin diffractive/reflective optical membrane focusing a narrowband signal onto a detector; support, focusing and pointing hardware required
interstellar_relay_chain.braking: Each node brakes independently after deployment using assumed 0.5c effective exhaust; fuel, containment, power, cooling and stationkeeping must fit its allocation
interstellar_relay_chain.stationary_definition: Approximately at rest in a chosen Solar-System-barycentric frame after braking, not fixed relative to Earth's orbit; transverse motion and stationkeeping unsolved
interstellar_relay_chain.deployment: Release before desired final location to allow braking; endpoint/acceleration-phase deployment trajectories remain to be solved
interstellar_relay_chain.storage: Compact deployment canister mounted directly to the flight superstructure; expanded receivers deploy after release
interstellar_relay_chain.mass_accounting: 100 kg cap includes matter/antimatter braking fuel, dry hardware, dispenser and development allowance; see mission-300-trade.json
interstellar_relay_chain.communications_role: Low-rate regenerative store-and-forward interstellar optical relay; no credit for replacing ship navigation, control, local radios or an independent survival link

remote_items.name: Additional shared deployment, relay and support hardware

mass_accounting: All remote vehicle fuel, containment, power, cooling, shielding, communications, instruments and support are inside these allocations
space_probe_release: Before main-ship descent at suitable destination trajectories; no main-ship relaunch

crewed_rover.concept: Pressurised electric utility rover for two occupants, remotely operable; cruise service pod becomes rover cabin
crewed_rover.cruise_use_of_pressure_cabin: Flight workshop/service room; final room allocation and location pending
mass_includes: Reused cabin and equipment counted once in departure mass
crewed_rover.range_and_endurance: Two people for seven days required; driving range and contingency reserves not yet sized
